caseBoundary.statement: K2 and K3 are separately reproducible reference artifacts presented in one product case. Their geometries are not asserted to be identical; cross-engine causal inference is prohibited.

layers.label: depthmapX reference output
layers.claim: depthmapX 0.9.1 VGA local visibility produced 263 points with mean Connectivity 124.8, minimum 65 and maximum 200.
layers.prohibitedUse: Do not rename Connectivity as qi, fortune, health, or life outcome.

layers.label: Radiance reference output
layers.claim: Radiance 6.0.2 produced 20 workplane illuminance values: mean 771.6 lx, minimum 421.2 lx, maximum 1976.2 lx, near-window mean 1049.2 lx and deep-zone mean 494.0 lx.

provenance.scope: fixed 5 m x 4 m x 3 m room, Guangzhou clear-sky point in time

layers.allowedUse: Report the point-in-time modeled illuminance distribution.
layers.prohibitedUse: Do not claim annual daylight performance, user-home measurement, qi, or auspiciousness.

layers.label: 《宅经》住宅论述
layers.claim: The received text treats the dwelling as a distinct object of traditional judgement.

source.excerpt: 夫宅者，乃是陰陽之樞紐，人倫之軌模。
source.period: received premodern text; exact authorship/date unresolved in this product

layers.allowedUse: Show that a residential interpretive tradition exists and preserve its own vocabulary.
layers.prohibitedUse: The passage does not validate any numerical daylight, visibility, health, wealth, or event prediction.

layers.label: 《葬书》风与水语句
layers.claim: The received text links dispersal with wind and stopping with water in a burial/site-selection discourse.

source.period: received text appears in later bibliographic transmission; exact original authorship unresolved

layers.allowedUse: Describe the wording and its burial/landscape scope.
layers.prohibitedUse: Do not equate wind with Radiance, water with depthmapX, or extend burial claims to indoor residential outcomes.

layers.label: 二十四山名称与次序
layers.claim: The frozen source supports names, composition and cyclic order used by the direction normalizer.
layers.allowedUse: Normalize a measured azimuth into a named 24-mountain sector under the product's explicit 15-degree engineering convention.
layers.prohibitedUse: The source binding does not authorize environmental, causal or auspiciousness conclusions.

layers.label: 南窗与采光梯度的现代解释
layers.claim: For the K3 model inputs, distance from the south window is associated with a modeled illuminance gradient.
layers.allowedUse: Explain the K3 model output under its stated geometry and sky.
layers.prohibitedUse: Do not treat this as proof of a traditional south-facing rule or as a result for another dwelling.

layers.label: 现代指标等同气或吉凶
layers.claim: Connectivity or illuminance directly measures qi, auspiciousness, health, wealth, or future events.
layers.allowedUse: Display only as a blocked claim requiring independent evidence and an operational definition.
layers.prohibitedUse: Do not use in recommendations or status decisions.

decisionRules.then: report value, engine, artifact, units and scope
report work, excerpt, witness, attribution/transmission status and original scope
BLOCK unless an explicit operational bridge and independent evidence exist

decisionRules.if: geometry continuity between K2 and K3 is requested
decisionRules.then: return NOT_PROVEN and prohibit cross-engine causal inference
